name: gemini-book-to-skill
description: Turn any technical book, PDF, EPUB, DOCX, or documentation folder into a structured, on-demand Gemini and Google Antigravity skill with chapters, mental models, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. Free, MIT.
suggestedPrompts: Use book-to-skill to convert ./my-book.pdf into a structured skill
Use book-to-skill to analyze ./docs/ and preview the extracted frameworks before generating
Run book-to-skill --check to see which document extractors are installed
